name: sublime_epiphany_target_player_draws_beside_another_target
note: Sublime Epiphany with two modes (the set {2, 4}: '• Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.' and '• Target player draws a card.'), P0 targeting P1's Opp Bear and P0 itself. The Bear returns to P1's hand, and P0, the designated player, draws. Red before 2026-11-13: a designated-player read in a designation of several slots took the first handle of the union of the slots, the Bear, and drew for its controller (P1's hand 2, P0's 0); it now reads its own slot (selectors.designated_player).
